biotools.summary: The Cattle Quantitative Trait Locus (QTL) Database (Cattle QTLdb) curates cattle QTL and association data from published literature to facilitate gene discovery related to important cattle production traits. The database contains data from 1,225 publications, lifted to build Btau5.0.
